title: Coding LLMs Can Be Harnessed to Learn Interpretable Models from Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.14006v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Since compact, interpretable classifiers correspond to simple programs, it is natural to ask if LLM-based coding agents can be used to learn interpretable models from data. In this paper we present a simple harness that repeatedly prompts a coding LLM to produce the next rule in a rule set, given a sample of labeled examples. We show that this approach is competitive with, and often superior to, state-of-the-art rule-learning methods on tabular data, especially with small training sets, and wins by large margins on text, including against another LLM-based rule learner; that this approach outperforms standard harnesses, and that the approach immediately leads to new kinds of interpretable models, since coding agents are not restricted to search a highly restricted hypothesis space. In addition to the advances made in learning interpretable models, these results are of interest because they introduce a new class of coding benchmarks - c

translated_title: 编码大语言模型可被用于从数据中学习可解释模型
translated_abstract: 由于紧凑、可解释的分类器对应于简单的程序，一个自然的问题是：能否利用基于大语言模型（LLM）的编码智能体从数据中学习可解释模型。在本文中，我们提出了一个简单的框架，该框架在给定带标签样本的情况下，反复提示编码型大语言模型生成规则集中的下一条规则。我们证明，该方法在表格数据上与最先进的规则学习方法相比具有竞争力且往往更优，尤其是在训练集较小的情况下；在文本数据上则以大幅优势获胜，包括战胜了另一个基于大语言模型的规则学习器；该方法优于标准框架；并且由于编码智能体不受限于在高度受限的假设空间中搜索，该方法直接催生了新型可解释模型。除了在可解释模型学习方面取得的进展外，这些结果之所以值得关注，还因为它们引入了一类新的编码基准——可解释模型学习基准。
tldr: 本文提出一个简单框架，通过反复提示编码型大语言模型逐条生成规则来构建可解释模型，在表格和文本数据上达到或超越最先进规则学习方法的性能，同时催生了新型可解释模型和一类新的编码基准。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a simple harness that repeatedly prompts a coding LLM to generate rules from labeled data, achieving competitive or superior performance over state-of-the-art rule-learning methods on tabular and text data, while enabling new kinds of interpretable models and a new class of coding benchmarks.
